name: io.github.EarthyPunyapat/invoiceflow
title: InvoiceFlow
description: Create invoices, clients, and payable Stripe Checkout links from an agent. Seven tools over stdio JSON-RPC with no dependencies. No tool sends email, deletes, refunds, or pays — creation is additive and a human can undo it. Amounts are integer cents and a non-integer is refused rather than rounded.

environmentVariables.name: INVOICEFLOW_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: InvoiceFlow API key, created in Settings -> API keys. Must begin with ifk_. Without it the server still lists tools, but every call returns an actionable error.

environmentVariables.name: INVOICEFLOW_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to the hosted app.
